source: 外研社必修三 Unit 2 同主题完形(乡村取水/班级义卖/做志愿者/旧衣捐赠/为孩子读书/环保助人)。用词限 U2/初中/常见词,4选项同词性、无双解,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。

passages.title: Water for a Village
passages.text: In many parts of the world, getting clean water is still a daily (1)____. In one small village, the children once had to walk for hours to (2)____ water from a dirty river. The water often made them (3)____, and many of them missed school. Then a charity decided to (4)____ a project to help. Workers came to (5)____ a deep well right in the centre of the village. They also taught the families how to (6)____ rainwater so that nothing was wasted. Slowly, life began to (7)____. The children grew healthy enough to study, and their parents could grow more food. The whole village felt deeply (8)____ to everyone who had helped. Their story is a clear (9)____ that even a little clean water can completely (10)____ people's lives.

dig a well 挖井。
store rainwater 储存雨水;与'nothing was wasted'呼应。

passages.title: A Charity Sale at School
passages.text: Last month, our class organised a charity (1)____ to raise money for children in need. Everyone was asked to bring something they no longer (2)____, such as old books, toys or clothes. questions.explanation: a charity sale 慈善义卖。

came to buy 来买东西。

tired but happy 累但开心。

passages.title: Becoming a Volunteer

questions.explanation: wanted to help others 想帮助别人。
become a volunteer 成为志愿者。
a centre that offered help 提供帮助的中心。

passages.title: Old Clothes, New Hope
passages.text: Every winter, our neighbourhood holds a drive to collect warm (1)____ for families who cannot afford them. People bring coats, gloves and blankets that they no longer (2)____. The clean, tidy clothes are then (5)____ to shelters around the city. Last year I joined the drive for the first time. At first I thought my small (6)____ would not matter much. But when I saw how (7)____ the families were, I understood that even one coat could keep a child warm. One little girl gave me a huge (8)____ when she put on her new gloves. That moment (9)____ me to keep helping. Now I look (10)____ to the clothes drive every single winter.

questions.explanation: warm clothes 暖和的衣物。

my small effort 我小小的付出。

gave me a huge smile 给我一个大大的微笑。

passages.title: Reading to Children
passages.text: Once a week, a group of students from our school (1)____ a nearby hospital to read to sick children. Many of these children must stay in bed for a long (2)____ and often feel lonely. When we read, we use different voices to make each character come (5)____. The children listen with wide eyes and often ask us to read the same story (6)____. Their happiness is the best (7)____ we could ask for. One boy told me that our visits were the part of the week he (8)____ most. Hearing that, I felt that our time was truly well (9)____. questions.explanation: students visit a hospital 学生探访医院。

forget their pain 暂时忘记疼痛。
choose books 挑选书。
come alive 变得活灵活现。

the best reward 最好的回报。
